title: Primer of Qi in the Whirling Weight
summary: Teaches qi-fed whirling of the chain weight, with a step to circle the foe, to students who already hold a basic text.

title: Handbook of Chain Entanglement
summary: Covers wrapping casts, coils around hafts and the binding pull that brings an entangled opponent to the ground.

title: The Kama and Chain Compendium
summary: Gathers the plain combinations in which the weight opens a guard and the blade closes it, with a reach switch.

title: Treatise on Binding the Blade Arm
summary: Teaches how to catch, wrap and lock an armed opponent's arm with the chain, hook and weight together.

title: Drill-Book of the Spinning Guard
summary: Drills the whirling ring of chain as a moving guard that can loose the weight at an opening.

title: A Complete Course in Reach Control
summary: Sets out how to hold, shorten and lengthen the fighting range of kama and chain, with feints and a closing rush.

title: Workbook of Hook and Pull
summary: Gives qi-using students drills in hooking limbs, belts and weapons and dragging them off balance.

title: Canon of the Two-Range Fighter
summary: Teaches the shift between close hook work and far weight casts, and the pull that closes the gap.
